comment: Custom single-repeat delay with CLEAN/TAPE character, switchable PRE/POST booster, three-band EQ, variable delay time and echo mix. The DSP checks ctx[3] bounds and adapts its stereo ring to the available arena.
fxid_comment: 0x0393. Checked against tools/effects_db.json on 2026-10-30; no existing entry uses (gid=8, fxid=915).

params.name: Bass
params.comment: Low-band gain; centre is neutral, ends approximately -6/+6 dB.

params.name: Mid
params.comment: Mid-band gain; centre is neutral, ends approximately -6/+6 dB.

params.name: Trebl
params.comment: High-band gain; centre is neutral, ends approximately -6/+6 dB.

params.name: Time
params.comment: 20 ms to the largest safe delay supported by the reported ctx[3] arena; capacity-dependent.

params.name: Echo
params.comment: Single-repeat dry/wet mix. Feedback is deliberately fixed at zero in v1.

audio_nop_comment: G1Xon safety gate: default build is a UI-only smoke ZDL. Set BBDELAY_ENABLE_DSP=1 only after the target pedal's ZDL loading and state arena have been verified.
